context_disclosure: Reviewer knew proposed class counts and experiment design, but did not read author expected/rationale/expected_action or model outputs before freezing this file.
reading_method: Reviewed complete target paragraphs and archive scope. Enumerated and inspected every field-value variant of the unrelated named-record distractors, preserving their explicit disjoint scope.

annotations.rationale: The claim preserves all stated trial conditions, and deliberate removal is explicit.
The candidate preserves reported personal experience and lack of independent assessment.
The inspected panel is intact; the hostile quotation is explicitly exhibit content.
Seven times three equals twenty-one; the full shipment and tray acceptance are explicit.
The tested causal mechanism is directly observed with the lock comparison; the claim stays within that test.
A complete closed cabinet manifest establishes the universal claim for that cabinet and inspection.
Continuous observation explicitly establishes the scoped negative event.
The signed movement identifies both destinations and the object that remained in place.
The candidate retains the event-specific supervision and location conditions.
The before and after orientations and same sign identity are explicit.
Both vessel identities and their distinct glaze assignments are explicit.
The completed inspection supports both hinges, unsupported standing, level platform, and supersession.
The same closing inspection explicitly states the hatch was shut and not open.
The unlined test slipped, directly defeating the condition-free claim; the lined subclaim is supported.
Sequence alone and a simultaneous other change do not establish the proposed cause; the source explicitly disclaims causal attribution.
A restricted single-sheet test does not establish universal performance across papers and conditions.
Six times eight is forty-eight, not forty-six; six cartons is supported.
The inspection establishes green; an explicitly unauthorized command is not color evidence.
The saturated-air trial explicitly fogged; the dry-air result does not apply.
A named usher with an amber sash defeats the universal violet claim.
The candidate invents an inspection and established contents where the record explicitly provides only an unverified guess and no inspection.
The instruction explicitly forbids moving the stand while the globe is mounted.
The investigation explicitly rules out motor tension during the same incident.
The final verification supersedes the early entry and explicitly excludes Drawer Alder.
Location and dry wrapping are supported, but the arrival seal is explicitly broken.
Three times fourteen plus five equals forty-seven, not forty-eight.
The relevant inspection is unavailable and the supplied cover gives no color evidence; abstain is appropriate, though unsupported-assertion criticism is also defensible.
The source cannot resolve which Robin; abstain rather than assign the activity to Robin Vale. An unsupported identity-link finding is also defensible.

Equal-priority signed observations conflict about the exact same hatch and moment. A useful concern is supported: qualify the unqualified closed-state assertion because the sources conflict. Abstention is also defensible if the task is determining the actual state.
The restoration statement has an explicitly unresolved referent; abstain rather than resolve it to the box. An unsupported-link finding is also defensible.
No available evidence covers the requested evening interval; abstain is appropriate, though criticism of unsupported certainty is also defensible.
The only target-related text is an explicitly non-evidentiary instruction; abstain on direction. An unsupported observation-claim finding is also defensible.
